title: Anti-rug health signals do not track protection: the dashboard shows connected while no rug-log subscription exists, the reconnect-failure and >60 s alerts cannot fire, skipped registrations and failed verification are only logged, and new buys arm anti-rug on a chain that failed verification

evidence.note: the heartbeat re-broadcasts connected on every healthy tick without checking that a subscription exists
with zero positions no subscription is installed, yet connected is broadcast
the HTTP fallback reports connected before its first poll

a constructed provider counts as reconnected and the loop exits; consecutiveFailures (:946) and the >60 s tier (:889-914) need a loop pass a refused connect never reaches (it crashes, AUD-ANTIRUG-002)
the alerts are awaited inside the reconnect loop (also :974-977)
a missing baseline only logs; the position is silently unmonitored for anti-rug
an allowlist verify RPC failure only logs and skips the chain at resume
comment: a failed chain "truly runs without anti-rug monitoring"
a later V2 buy still calls registerAntiRugPosition, which arms the listener against the unverified allowlist (V3 at :1492)
verify is a serial getCode per entry; an entry with no code ends the process with exit(1)

sibling_sites_checked: Every chain_ws_health_change broadcast (detector.ts:689, :800, :864, :908, :1244) and every sendCtxAlert in the slice (detector.ts:904, :974, :1064; exitTrigger.ts:195, :288; circuitBreaker.ts:156). The dashboard side of the badge (dashboard/src) is the DASH slice and was not read here.
severity_rationale: S2. The operator only sees anti-rug protection through these signals, and they say connected in exactly the situations where positions are unprotected (after a dashboard stop, AUD-ANTIRUG-001; with no positions; with a dead poller). Indirect capital effect: the operator does not act.
recommendation: Define health as "subscription installed on a live provider and a log or block seen recently"; alert (not only log) on a skipped registration, a failed verify and a failed backfill; give the alert calls a timeout or fire them without awaiting inside the reconnect loop; what a failed verify means for new buys is card ANTIRUG-06. Phase 24 for the verify policy, Phase 29 for the signal fixes.
